answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The fable of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The cedar lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the vault is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
